_meta.name: bootstrap_resample
_meta.description: Bootstrap resampling: REG_OLS with resample=bootstrap replaces analytical std errors with empirical-distribution estimates over 200 with-replacement bootstrap iterations (rng_seed=42 for determinism). Sibling shape to 09_jackknife.json — the bootstrap arm is the canonical large-sample resampling estimator; jackknife is the leave-one-out approximation. Forces the buffered orchestrator path (the bootstrap fold needs the materialised record set).
